candidate.name: robotic demonstrator / Butter Bot source-review candidate

gates: Verify source files, exact units/scale and source hashes.
Verify licence/redistribution/commercial/character rights before publishing or distributing derivatives.
Create an authorised derivation root; preserve canonical source unchanged.
Bind exact BOM, motors/servos/controllers, power/current, torque/load, thermal and stability budgets.
Bind PC01 machine/tool/process capability and independent C0 safe-stop path.
Run source-bound twin, baseline solve, sequence, collision/process checks, render and review.
Only a frozen packet with every applicable hard readiness dimension PASS may become BUILD_READY.
first_physical_preference: Benign P0/P1/P2 coupons should execute before a complex powered robotic article.
evidence_rule: Publicly readable source is not automatically licensed open hardware; digital review is not physical qualification.
